Post Message: “This work is urgent,” says Sabin Vaccine Institute President of Global Immunization Rebecca Martin on today’s announcement of a new partnership with Population Services International (PSI) aimed at increasing access to vaccines by optimizing the role of pharmacies and other private-sector providers in expanding access to essential health services.  More than 13.5 million children worldwide received no vaccine protection in their first year of life in 2025, according to the latest WHO/UNICEF Estimates of Vaccination Coverage released in July 2026.   The collaboration brings together Sabin’s expertise in immunization and generating and translating evidence for vaccine policy and program implementation with PSI’s experience implementing, scaling and strengthening health delivery in communities to  connect people where they are with high-quality services through providers they know and trust.  See the press release ⤵️ https://ow.ly/LLv450ZNpNR
